name: consumer-smoke
description: A minimal outside-project Vite app that imports @tlslides/tldraw from its BUILT dist, exactly as a real downstream consumer would (see run.sh). Not a workspace member — see the root package.json/pnpm-workspace.yaml exclusion — so it gets none of the monorepo's workspace links or shared tsconfig paths that let the in-repo examples succeed even when the published package is broken.
